They can’t get in, but if I look directly at them, they’ll know I see them, and then it’ll start. That’s why I keep the curtains closed, even at noon.  

I haven’t left the house in months. Not because of the storm—but because I know they’ve poisoned the rain. It’s not water—it’s liquid eyes, spying. My daughter says it’s just fear, but it’s not. I *know* what’s really happening.
